catalogue_card.question: Which AI-agent skills are useful for marketing, and how can marketers use them?
catalogue_card.text: Match a source-inspected skill to a specific job and keep first use reviewable. Six entries remain, including conditional, draft-only emails; none was independently tested. Run 12 deferred a prelaunch-QA skill search, kept UTM governance separate and found no evidence of added value over a spreadsheet checklist and human review. Superamped provenance stops and Run 7 freshness limits remain.

summary: Prelaunch QA compares approved offer, audience, exclusions, assets, destinations, budget caps, conversion-event intent, tracking strings and approvals with a dated owner-supplied setup record. It reports matches, draft discrepancies and missing evidence, not live readiness.

UTM/naming governance owns allowed values, creation and enforcement across channels and time. The QA job has one narrow interface: compare supplied strings with the approved specification; do not design or enforce the taxonomy.

Community reports identify plausible setup and naming problems, while spreadsheets, reviewed prompts and connected platform tools remain credible alternatives. There is no comparative evidence that a portable skill adds value.
No seventh entry, package search, installation, account connection, live check, send or spend action occurred.
uncertainty: Practitioner accounts are self-selected and unverified; some promote products. Official Google help describes features and limitations, not observed QA effectiveness. No pool analytics, interviews, consented artifacts, control comparison, defect counts or time savings were available.
No live account setting, destination, redirect chain, GA4 receipt, conversion firing, consent, policy status or campaign outcome was inspected. An offline match does not establish launch readiness.

The six packages were not rechecked. Four Superamped selected-file SHA/date and tag findings remain unresolved; emails lacks a selected-file pin and remains conditional/draft-only; Copywriting’s dated record is not a current-branch pin; Run 7 did not verify current-day selected-directory listings.
